Meeting AI

## Make Every Meeting  
More Meaningful

Meeting AI automates your prospect and customer research, delivering it to your inbox every morning with the intelligence you need before every call.

### Revolutionize Sales Prep & Enhance Client Meetings

## 82%

of B2B decision-makers perceive sales representatives as unprepared.

## 65%

of reps say time constraints prevent them from conducting pre-call research.

## 51%

Boost in productivity when incorporating AI tools.

### Maximize the Impact of Every Customer Meeting

Leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, Meeting AI supplies users with comprehensive insights on companies and contacts ahead of scheduled meetings. Utilize activities and details from our **Salesforce integration**, to enhance preparedness, build meaningful connections, and drive better outcomes.

![automated-research-delivery-meeting-ai](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Screenshot%202025-10-14%20at%2011.31.39%20AM%201%20\(1\).png?width=578&height=632&name=Screenshot%202025-10-14%20at%2011.31.39%20AM%201%20\(1\).png)

### Your Morning Research, Done For You

Meeting AI takes care of the pre-meeting prep that usually eats into your mornings. Each day, it automatically scans your connected calendar, identifies your external meetings, and delivers actionable research straight to your inbox before the day begins.

Instead of jumping between LinkedIn, Salesforce, and multiple data sources, you get a single, easy-to-digest summary of:

*   **Who you’re meeting:** Key contacts, roles, and relationship history
    
*   **Which companies they represent:** Company overviews, firmographics, and recent activity
    
*   **Why it matters:** Timely signals, notes, and recommended talking points
    

### Convert Meetings to Revenue with AI-Automated Prep

Let AI handle pre-meeting research so you can focus on what really drives revenue, the conversation.

Meeting AI gathers and surfaces what matters most from Salesforce and trusted sources, giving you everything you need to convert meetings into revenue. 

### How Meeting AI Works

![number-one](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/number-one.png?height=60&name=number-one.png)

#### Calendar Scanning

Each morning, Meeting AI reviews your upcoming external appointments.

![number-2](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/number-2.png?height=60&name=number-2.png)

#### Intelligence Gathering

We pull from Salesforce activity, public web data, and vetted third-party sources to build your briefing.

![number-3](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/number-3.png?height=60&name=number-3.png)

#### Morning Email Delivery

You'll receive a concise, actionable research digest for every meeting scheduled that day.

![number-four](https://www.cirrusinsight.com/hs-fs/hubfs/number-four.png?height=60&name=number-four.png)

#### Instant Access In-App

Get more data in the Meeting AI dashboard: Company Activity, Relationships, History, Buyer Signals, and more.
